# External geometric-products port

This is a client of the public Worlds 0.5 API.  It recreates the main
0.4 geometric-products pressure tests without semantic sorts or a product-specific
kernel path.

It tests Counter factorisation/scarcity, sibling positive supply, keyed Entry
handoff, whole-candidate Theory selection, cyclic mutual support, sibling
permutation invariance and complete-candidate observation.

`each` is represented by `Algebra.tensor`; `together` by tensor plus internal
`Algebra.close` Cuts.  No `Constraint`, `Supply`, `Each` or `Together` carrier is
introduced into Worlds.
